welcome.title: Hi, I’m
welcome.description: I build hardware projects and use Crucible to document what I test, break, learn, and rebuild.
welcome.intro: It’s where I keep my schematics, measurements, code, decisions, and the dead ends along the way.

points.title: What I’m building
points.description: I log the goals, parts, wiring, firmware, measurements, and results behind each build.

points.title: How I got there
points.description: I keep experiments, references, and design decisions close to the work that shaped them.

points.title: The honest version
points.description: I record what worked, what failed, and what I want to try next—not just the polished result.

contact.title: Say hello
contact.description: Want to talk hardware, compare notes, or ask about one of my projects? These are the best places to reach me.
contact.note: I’m always happy to hear from fellow builders, curious tinkerers, and anyone who found something useful in my project logs.
